decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The use of an area of St Giles Square for a seasonal winter market event hereby permitted for a temporary period only shall cease on or before 28/12/2025. All chalet structures and equipment associated with the market event shall then be removed and the site made good on or before 30/12/2025.

Reason: The structures and equipment are not such as the Council is prepared to approve, other than for a limited period, in view of their appearance. The permanent retention of the structures and equipment would be contrary to the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan; 201 rev 2 to 203 rev 2 (inclusive); 204 rev 3 (existing and proposed section west); 205 rev 1; 207 rev 2 to 209 rev 2 (inclusive); 204.1 (proposed chalet plan & elevation); Supporting statements from Cirrus Kitchens Ltd - Planning Statement dated 08/09/2025, Design and Access Statement dated October 2025, Construction Logistics Plan, Visitor Management Plan, Delivery and Servicing Plan, Operating Statement (all dated September 2025); Noise Management Plan from RNSS Ltd. dated September 2025; Additional Transport and Delivery details (email from Cirrus Kitchens Ltd.) dated 21/11/2025.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The use of an area of St. Giles Square for a seasonal winter market event hereby permitted shall not be carried out outside the following times: 11am - 9.30pm, Monday and Tuesday; 11am - 10pm, Wednesday to Saturday; and 11am - 9pm on Sunday.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, A1, A4 and TC6 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - No live music shall be played in connection with the seasonal winter market event hereby permitted. No recorded music shall be played in such a way as to be audible from within any neighbouring residential premises and shall only be played within the times specified in Condition 3 of this approval.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, A4 and TC6 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - No loading or unloading of goods in connection with the seasonal winter market event hereby permitted shall be carried out otherwise than from loading bays in Denmark Street and shall not be carried out outside the following times: 7am - 10am and 4pm - 7pm, Monday to Saturday. No loading or unloading of goods shall take place on Sunday.

Reason: To avoid obstruction of the surrounding streets and to safeguard amenities of adjacent premises in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, A4 and T4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Temporary use of an area of St Giles Square for a seasonal winter market including food and market stalls between 6 November 2025 and 28 December 2025, with set-up & site clearance between 27 October 2025 and 30 December 2025 (retrospective).
